narrative.overview:
The site reads like a ruled technical notebook typeset by someone who cares about type: warm near-black ink (or warm paper in light mode), hairline rules instead of boxes, a plain mono label in the margin column, and one tall, narrow, light sans voice for headlines. Information is annotated rather than decorated: mono metadata labels, numbered index rows, and a single vermilion mark that shows where attention should go.

The mood is quiet, exact and product-engineering. Density is generous at the section level (large vertical rhythm) and tight within entries. Nothing glows, floats or gradients; hierarchy comes from the contrast between a light condensed display and small mono labels, and from rules that divide the page.

This system is the incumbent implementation in `src/app/globals.css`. The blue "Kinetic Technical" palette in CLAUDE.md is not what ships and is not part of this system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome ink/paper with a single vermilion accent.
Light condensed display (Sofia Sans Condensed) over a neutral sans body (Geist) and mono labels (Geist Mono).
12-column editorial grid: a 3-column margin for labels, a 9-column main column.
Hairline rules and flat surfaces; no shadows, no gradients, no cards-as-boxes.
Dark is the primary theme; light is a true paper variant, not an inversion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears on a small fraction of any screen. Its rarity is the point; if two things on a screen are vermilion at rest, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are warm-tinted, never pure black or pure white or cool gray.

rules.name: The Quiet Headline Rule
rules.body: Only the hero, Work, the featured project and Contact get a display or headline-size title; every other section is announced by its mono label alone. Light weight (300) only at 2rem and above; titles below that use 400.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows or gradients. State changes are shown by color and border shifts, a link underline growing in, or a 2px–8px nudge.

dos: open sections with a mono label in the 3-column margin and, only where the section needs one, a light display headline in the main column. No section numbers.
use the vermilion accent sparingly, on emphasis, focus and hover only.
separate content with 1px rules rather than boxes or shadows.
show every focus state: a 2px vermilion outline with a 3px offset.
honor `prefers-reduced-motion` (animations and transitions collapse to near-zero).
crossfade theme changes: a 450ms view transition on the root, with a 400ms color/border transition as the fallback, and an instant switch under reduced motion.
keep stack lines and metadata in Geist Mono.
donts: use the CLAUDE.md "Kinetic Technical" blue (`#3b82f6`) or pure black (`#000`) anywhere; they are not part of the shipped system.
add shadows, gradients, glows or rounded cards.
fill a section with decorative statistics, `Fig.` labels or filler labels; headline stat strips are not part of this system.
use more than one accent color.
use the display face below 1.25rem, set it in italic, or color a headline word with the accent.
reintroduce a serif; the system has no serif role.
